name: LookupRangeInExcelWorksheet
label: Lookup Range in Excel Worksheet
description: Performs a LOOKUP operation in an Excel worksheet. Searches for a lookup value in a single row or column and returns a value from the same position in another row or column.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object where the lookup will be performed. If not provided, the active sheet of the workbook will be used.

fields.name: LookupValue
fields.label: Lookup Value
fields.description: The value to search for in the lookup range.

fields.name: RangesFormat
fields.label: Ranges Format
fields.description: Specifies how the ranges are defined: Named Cells or Specific Ranges.

selectOptions.label: Specific Ranges
selectOptions.description: Uses explicit start/end columns/rows for lookup.

fields.name: CellsName
fields.label: Cells Name
fields.description: The name of the named range to use for lookup (required if 'Ranges Format' is 'Named Cells').

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the lookup range (required if 'Ranges Format' is 'Specific Ranges').

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the lookup range (required if 'Ranges Format' is 'Specific Ranges').

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the lookup range (required if 'Ranges Format' is 'Specific Ranges').

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the lookup range (required if 'Ranges Format' is 'Specific Ranges').

fields.name: ArrayForm
fields.label: Array Form
fields.description: If true, performs array-based lookup; otherwise, performs scalar lookup.

fields.name: StartColumnOfResultsSource
fields.label: Start Column of Results Source
fields.description: The starting column of the result range (required if 'Array Form' is false).

fields.name: StartRowOfResultsSource
fields.label: Start Row of Results Source
fields.description: The starting row of the result range (required if 'Array Form' is false).

fields.name: EndColumnOfResultsSource
fields.label: End Column of Results Source
fields.description: The ending column of the result range (required if 'Array Form' is false).

fields.name: EndRowOfResultsSource
fields.label: End Row of Results Source
fields.description: The ending row of the result range (required if 'Array Form' is false).

fields.name: LookupResult
fields.label: Lookup Result
fields.description: Returns the matched result from the result range based on the lookup value.
